adjudication.depicted_input: Shared H2O architecture/training panel showing paired H&E image patches and spatial sequencing inputs entering the image/ST foundation-model alignment pipeline for ST prediction.
adjudication.rationale: The current crop is defensible for the listed fine-tuning route. It visibly shows the route-specific input objects and immediate interface: H&E imaging patches, spatial sequencing input, image/ST foundation-model representations, and their contrastive alignment within the training procedure. Under the atlas rules, the exact variant name need not appear when the paper uses a shared architecture figure for variants with the same depicted input mechanism, and training/fine-tuning input is valid scope. The crop therefore supports the H2O-ccRCC fine-tuning route because it depicts the paired alignment input mechanism stated for that route.
